scenes.name: FlexibleRoom
scenes.note: This environment is a manually built, simple, and expandable abstract training setup where all agents and obstacles are placed in an empty room. Users can randomize obstacles (such as cubes, cones, etc.), the floor, agent textures, sizes, and the lighting conditions of the environment.
